definition: A person who holds a policy with us or who is claiming on one
example: A driver reporting a collision on their own policy
non_example: A person who only asked for a quote

definition: The person named on the policy who bought the cover
example: The named driver on a motor policy bought online
non_example: A passenger who is not named on the policy

definition: The urgency group a new claim is placed in so the most urgent is handled first
example: Urgent for a claim where someone is hurt
